I replied to Dana in our DM to confirm I have the note: they now use Dock 15 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups, and I'll keep it private.

I checked GBrain first, as your instructions ask. It has notes on Tamsin Cold Chain but nothing about which dock Dana uses, so nothing there conflicts with what they told me.

I didn't save the dock number to GBrain or to my memory files. Other members can read GBrain, and my memory carries into conversations with them, so saving it there could break Dana's request to keep it between us. The record is the DM itself, and I told Dana to ask me there when they need it. I took no other action.
